senses.gloss:
oṃ-kṛta, a. having an uttered om, accompanied^1
by om. [the natural order would
require kṛtaum: order inverted to avoid
such an undeclinable stem.]
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210219. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/52.
